title: Add GA4 and Meta Pixel
prompt: Add Google Analytics 4 and the Meta Pixel to our Next.js site so we can run retargeting ads.
must: Gates marketing and analytics tags behind a consent choice before they load
Sets Google Consent Mode defaults to denied before the tag loads
Offers reject as easily as accept in the banner
Records Meta and Google as operators and cross-border transfers (s72)
Cites the Regulator's direct marketing guidance or s69 for marketing tracking
must_not: Loads the Meta Pixel or GA4 unconditionally on page load
Claims hashing makes the data anonymous
